# Choosing a home brewer

Home brewers come in many shapes, and the right one depends on how much time you have each morning.

## Moka pot vs espresso machine

A moka pot is cheap, small and works on any stove, while an espresso machine costs more but gives you real pressure and a steam wand for milk. The moka pot makes a strong, slightly bitter cup; the machine makes a thicker shot with crema.

## Recommended settings

- **Grind:** fine
- **Dose:** 18 g
- **Time:** 28 s
